```{ojs}
crlbMu = 0
crlbN = crlbControls.n
crlbSigma = crlbControls.sigma
crlbRelativeWeight = crlbControls.relativeWeight
crlbBound = crlbSigma ** 2 / crlbN
crlbEfficientSd = Math.sqrt(crlbBound)
crlbSelectedVariance = crlbSigma ** 2 *
  (crlbRelativeWeight ** 2 + crlbN - 1) /
  (crlbRelativeWeight + crlbN - 1) ** 2
crlbSelectedSd = Math.sqrt(crlbSelectedVariance)
crlbEfficiency = crlbBound / crlbSelectedVariance
crlbAttainsBound = Math.abs(crlbRelativeWeight - 1) < 1e-9

crlbNormalPdf = (x, mean, sd) =>
  Math.exp(-0.5 * ((x - mean) / sd) ** 2) /
  (sd * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI))

crlbDensityHalfWidth = 4.25 * Math.max(crlbEfficientSd, crlbSelectedSd)
crlbDensityDomain = [crlbMu - crlbDensityHalfWidth, crlbMu + crlbDensityHalfWidth]

crlbDensityData = d3.range(401).map(index => {
  const x = crlbDensityDomain[0] + index *
    (crlbDensityDomain[1] - crlbDensityDomain[0]) / 400;
  return {
    x,
    efficientDensity: crlbNormalPdf(x, crlbMu, crlbEfficientSd),
    selectedDensity: crlbNormalPdf(x, crlbMu, crlbSelectedSd)
  };
})

crlbDensityYMax = d3.max(crlbDensityData, point =>
  Math.max(point.efficientDensity, point.selectedDensity)
)

crlbVarianceCurve = d3.range(241).map(index => {
  const relativeWeight = 20 * index / 240;
  const variance = crlbSigma ** 2 *
    (relativeWeight ** 2 + crlbN - 1) /
    (relativeWeight + crlbN - 1) ** 2;
  return {relativeWeight, variance, bound: crlbBound};
})

crlbVarianceYMax = d3.max(crlbVarianceCurve, point => point.variance)
```

```{ojs}
crlbSamplingPlot = Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(520, Math.max(320, width / 2 - 18)),
  height: 330,
  marginLeft: 58,
  style: {
    background: "var(--plot-bg)",
    color: "var(--plot-fg)",
    fontFamily: bodyFont,
    fontSize: 13
  },
  x: {label: "Possible estimate", domain: crlbDensityDomain},
  y: {label: "Density", domain: [0, 1.12 * crlbDensityYMax], grid: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(crlbDensityData, {
      x: "x",
      y: "efficientDensity",
      fill: "var(--plot-fill-1)"
    }),
    Plot.areaY(crlbDensityData, {
      x: "x",
      y: "selectedDensity",
      fill: "var(--plot-fill-4)"
    }),
    Plot.line(crlbDensityData, {
      x: "x",
      y: "efficientDensity",
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-1)",
      strokeWidth: 2.7
    }),
    Plot.line(crlbDensityData, {
      x: "x",
      y: "selectedDensity",
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-4)",
      strokeWidth: 2.7,
      strokeDasharray: "6,4"
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([crlbMu], {
      stroke: "var(--plot-reference)",
      strokeWidth: 2,
      strokeDasharray: "5,4"
    }),
    Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "var(--plot-reference)"})
  ]
})

crlbVariancePlot = Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(520, Math.max(320, width / 2 - 18)),
  height: 330,
  marginLeft: 62,
  style: {
    background: "var(--plot-bg)",
    color: "var(--plot-fg)",
    fontFamily: bodyFont,
    fontSize: 13
  },
  x: {label: "Relative weight on first observation r", domain: [0, 20], grid: true},
  y: {
    label: "Estimator variance",
    domain: [0, 1.08 * crlbVarianceYMax],
    grid: true
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(crlbVarianceCurve, {
      x: "relativeWeight",
      y1: "bound",
      y2: "variance",
      fill: "var(--plot-fill-2)"
    }),
    Plot.line(crlbVarianceCurve, {
      x: "relativeWeight",
      y: "variance",
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-4)",
      strokeWidth: 2.8
    }),
    Plot.ruleY([crlbBound], {
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-1)",
      strokeWidth: 2.4,
      strokeDasharray: "6,4"
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([1], {
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-1)",
      strokeWidth: 1.8,
      strokeDasharray: "6,4"
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([crlbRelativeWeight], {
      stroke: "var(--plot-reference)",
      strokeWidth: 1.8
    }),
    Plot.dot([{
      relativeWeight: crlbRelativeWeight,
      variance: crlbSelectedVariance
    }], {
      x: "relativeWeight",
      y: "variance",
      r: 6,
      fill: "var(--plot-series-4)",
      stroke: "var(--plot-on-accent)",
      strokeWidth: 1.2
    }),
    Plot.text([{
      relativeWeight: 19.5,
      variance: crlbBound,
      label: "CRLB"
    }], {
      x: "relativeWeight",
      y: "variance",
      text: "label",
      textAnchor: "end",
      dy: -8,
      fill: "var(--plot-series-1)",
      fontSize: 12
    }),
    Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "var(--plot-reference)"})
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
crlbReadout = md`${tex`\operatorname{Var}(T_r)=${crlbSelectedVariance.toFixed(4)};\qquad
  \mathrm{CRLB}=\frac{\sigma^2}{n}=${crlbBound.toFixed(4)};\qquad
  \frac{\mathrm{CRLB}}{\operatorname{Var}(T_r)}=${crlbEfficiency.toFixed(3)}`}`

crlbInsight = crlbAttainsBound
  ? md`**Bound attained:** ${tex`r=1`} gives every observation equal weight, so ${tex`T_1=\bar X`}.`
  : md`**Above the bound:** ${tex`T_r`} remains unbiased, but unequal weighting creates excess variance.`

html`<div class="crlb-figure-shell ojs-figure-shell">
  <div class="crlb-plots ojs-plot-grid">
    <div class="crlb-plot-panel ojs-plot-panel">
      <strong>Sampling distributions of two unbiased estimators</strong>
      ${crlbSamplingPlot}
    </div>
    <div class="crlb-plot-panel ojs-plot-panel">
      <strong>How unequal weighting moves variance above the bound</strong>
      ${crlbVariancePlot}
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="crlb-legend" aria-label="Plot legend">
    <span><i class="crlb-efficient"></i> Efficient ${tex`\bar X`}</span>
    <span><i class="crlb-selected"></i> Selected ${tex`T_r`}</span>
    <span><i class="crlb-excess"></i> Excess variance above the CRLB</span>
    <span><i class="crlb-reference"></i> Selected ${tex`r`}</span>
  </div>

  <div class="crlb-readout" role="status" aria-live="polite">${crlbReadout}</div>
  <div class="crlb-insight">${crlbInsight}</div>
</div>

<style>
  .crlb-legend {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: .55rem 1.1rem;
    margin: .65rem 0;
    font-size: .88rem;
  }

  .crlb-efficient { width: 1.25rem; border-top: 3px solid var(--plot-series-1); display: inline-block; }
  .crlb-selected { width: 1.25rem; border-top: 3px dashed var(--plot-series-4); display: inline-block; }
  .crlb-excess { width: 1rem; height: .72rem; background: var(--plot-fill-2); border: 1px solid var(--plot-series-2); display: inline-block; }
  .crlb-reference { width: 1.25rem; border-top: 2px solid var(--plot-reference); display: inline-block; }
  .crlb-readout,
  .crlb-insight {
    margin: .65rem 0 0;

  }
  .crlb-readout > p,
  .crlb-insight > p { margin: 0; }
</style>`
```

```{ojs}
// Keep the controls mounted beneath the reactive figure.
viewof crlbControls = {
  const estimatorForm = Inputs.form({
    relativeWeight: Inputs.range([0, 20], {
      value: 1,
      step: 0.5,
      label: md`Relative weight ${tex`r`}`
    })
  }, {submit: false});

  const sampleForm = Inputs.form({
    n: Inputs.range([2, 50], {
      value: 10,
      step: 1,
      label: md`Sample size ${tex`n`}`
    }),
    sigma: Inputs.range([0.5, 3], {
      value: 1.5,
      step: 0.1,
      label: md`Known standard deviation ${tex`\sigma`}`
    })
  }, {submit: false});

  const root = html`<div class="controls-wrap">
    <details class="controls-root" open>
      <summary>Estimator controls</summary>
      <div class="controls-grid">
        <div class="controls-col"><h4>Estimator weighting</h4></div>
        <div class="controls-col"><h4>Sample</h4></div>
      </div>
    </details>
  </div>`;

  const columns = root.querySelectorAll(".controls-col");
  columns[0].append(estimatorForm);
  columns[1].append(sampleForm);

  Object.defineProperty(root, "value", {
    get: () => ({...estimatorForm.value, ...sampleForm.value})
  });

  return root;
}
```
